Hardik Pandya ruled out of New Zealand series with shin injury

Cricketer Hardik Pandya has been ruled out of the upcoming New Zealand series due to a fresh injury to his right shin. Scan reports revealed the injury, and he has been advised two weeks of complete rest. This setback means Pandya will also miss the Australia A games. The injury has impacted his comeback plans.
